meta_title: VPN Affiliate Program: Earn on Every Sale | VpnHood!
meta_description: Share your link, earn commission when someone buys VpnHood! through it. No credit to hold, no support to answer, and nothing to install. Free to join.
page_desc: The route with nothing to run. You share a link, we handle the sale, the delivery and the support, and you are paid a commission on what it brings in.
hero_alt: A megaphone sending out a link that lands as a stack of coins
how_title: Three steps, and none of them are work
how_desc: Everything happens in your account with us. There is nothing to install and nobody to email first.
s1_desc: Activate the affiliate program in your account. You are given a referral link and a dashboard that shows visits, sign-ups and commission.
s2_desc: Put it wherever your audience already is: a video description, a channel, a review, a comparison post, a pinned message. It works on every page of this site.
s3_desc: When someone follows your link and buys, the sale is credited to you. Your current rate, balance and payout terms are shown in the dashboard.
fit_yes_1: You have an audience but no billing system, and no wish to build one.
fit_yes_2: You do not want to hold credit, answer support, or be the merchant of record.
fit_yes_3: You would rather recommend a product than run a shop.
fit_no_1: You want your own prices and your own margin rather than a commission rate.
fit_no_2: You want the customer relationship, the renewals and the data to be yours.
fit_no_3: You are building a brand, not a recommendation.
why_desc: An audience in a censored market is a hard audience to recommend a VPN to, because most of them have already tried one that stopped working. This one is free to try on Android, open source, and built for exactly that problem.
cta_note: The affiliate area lives in your VpnHood! account. Sign in, or create an account first.
